# Import Activity

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:ImportActivity`](gmeow-ImportActivity.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/ImportActivity>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/provenance`](../../slices/provenance.md)

An activity that ingested an external source artifact (an import envelope such as a vCard file) and recorded the claims it carried. Carries the ingestion (transaction) time — when the system learned the claims, distinct from when they were asserted or when they hold.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:Activity`](gmeow-Activity.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:ImportActivity`](gmeow-ImportActivity.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:Activity`](gmeow-Activity.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
